body:
Reflex 0.10 reconnects through `hydrate_and_load`, but the auth middleware only recognized `hydrate`. After an authenticated user navigated to or reloaded a public page, the full snapshot replaced async-checked computed values with their placeholders without marking them for page-load redelivery.

Handle both hydration events so protected values are redelivered after identity resolution. Add unit regressions for repeated hydration, async sibling-state authorization, denied checks, and stale identities, and strengthen the browser regression to verify two successive reloads.

Validation:
- Reproduced the public-page browser failure before the fix on Reflex `main` (`e080fbf`).
- Reflex `main`: 1,184 unit tests passed (1 skipped), all 24 auth browser tests passed, and the strengthened repeated-reload regression passed.
- Reflex 0.9.12: 496 auth unit tests passed (6 skipped), and all 24 auth browser tests passed.
- Ruff lint and formatting passed. Pyright passed on 0.9.12; the seven import-export diagnostics on `main` were identical on the unchanged baseline.

Closes #252.
title: fix: restore protected async vars after Reflex 0.10 hydration
head: codex/fix-auth-hydration-reflex-010
